firm_data.firm_description: Abrams Fensterman, LLP is a full-service New York law firm representing healthcare professionals, physicians, licensed professionals, businesses, and institutions in regulatory, corporate, litigation, and transactional legal matters. Since founding the firm in 2000, it has overseen its growth into one of New York’s largest law firms.
notable_facts: Celebrating 25 years of impact and growth in 2026.
Integrated Rosenberg & Steinmetz PC in January 2026.
Robert Abrams honored with Lifetime Achievement Award by the Elder Law & Special Needs Section of the New York State Bar Association in 2025.

email.subject: AI for Abrams Fensterman, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Dawn,

I noticed Abrams Fensterman is already investing in advanced AI-solutions to handle matters with precision and speed. As you scale across ADR, appeals, and bankruptcy work, that focus on AI-driven efficiency is exactly what separates winning firms from the rest.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by Lake Success to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
